market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Dow's 300-point drop on strong jobs data signals rate-hike repricing. Oil above $97 and diesel at all-time highs create inflation headwinds. Trump's trade threats add policy noise. AI rally broadening provides equity support but Europe's risk-off and EM currency weakness cap upside. Expect 2-3% range-bound volatility through September.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle expanding into infrastructure and applications supports tech earnings. Defense supercycle from multi-theater conflicts provides structural demand. Energy inflation may moderate if Iran tensions de-escalate. Consumer weakness is a watch item. Fed policy path remains the dominant macro variable.
